answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 20 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the horizon solution is checked at the nectar gate and logged, the raven audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. A farm of 52 pays that 95 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
